audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is captured as EVEN (5.5/10) with Rell favored levels 1-5, first item, and Alistar taking over at 2+ items — matches the packet levelChart exactly (Rell x6, Alistar last).
audit.why: Rell's mounted W-knockup range beats Alistar's melee Q-W early, but Alistar's R (Unbreakable Will) plus stacked resistances let him tank the poke and outlast once itemized.
audit.corrected: n/a — rating and breakdown.difficulty already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and named a nonexistent Rell ability, 'E Full Tilt' — Rell's E is Attract and Repel, not Full Tilt.
audit.why: Alistar's Headbutt and Pulverize both run 14/13/12/11/10s; Rell's E resets 14/13/12/11/10s. Naming the real numbers and the real ability lets a player track the actual punish window instead of a vague fabricated one.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged dash-denied (Alistar's Pulverize/Trample deny Rell's W dash) and autoreset-burst-tell (Trample's auto-attack reset is the combo's tell) as applicable but unmentioned; breakdown.trading and the Do/Don't pair also had copy-paste bleed (dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles).
audit.why: Trample stacks on unit contact and its reset-stun is the actual signal to disengage, not the cast itself; Pulverize/Trample ground Rell's Crash Down dash. These are concrete, sourced interactions the copy-paste text buried.
audit.corrected: See edits to breakdown.trading, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Alistar's Headbutt: 14s at rank 1 down to 10s at max, matched by Pulverize's 14-10s — the gap after both land is your window. - Your E, Attract and Repel, resets 14-10s; hold it, don't poke with it. - R (120/100/80s) is one commit per fight, not two.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Wait for his Headbutt-Pulverize commit, then Magnet Storm the cluster — you steal the pick instead of feeding it.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: R'ing before Headbutt is spent lets him knock your catch loose — wait for the whiff, not the bluff.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Good trade: engage after his Headbutt-Pulverize whiffs, not into it. Bad trade: crashing W while his Trample is stacked — the auto-attack stun cancels your knockup and his Q/E ground your remount before you land.

edits.before: Late Rell makes clumps: R the formation, crash the center, and let the team bill the gravity.
edits.after: R Unbreakable Will plus stacked tankiness lets him soak your engage and outlast the poke.
